name: stream-deck-github-bridge
displayName: Stream Deck GitHub Utilities — Active Repo Bridge
description: Writes the currently active workspace's GitHub repo to a bridge file so the Stream Deck GitHub Utilities plugin can follow your editor.

commands.title: Stream Deck Bridge: Refresh Active Repo

streamDeckGitHubBridge.bridgePath.description: Override the bridge-file path. Leave empty to use the OS default (matches the plugin's default).

streamDeckGitHubBridge.debounceMs.description: How long to wait (ms) after a workspace/focus change before writing the bridge file. Prevents thrash when switching rapidly.
